coverageNotes: Recognizes the documented Convex boundary under supplied conditions. Does not establish independent implementation skill or all source requirements.

questions.concept: Vector filters are restricted to declared filterFields
questions.question: What happens during TypeScript checking and, if checking is bypassed, when the action runs?

options.text: Checking passes; the search returns only published hits.
options.rationale: status is a document field but is not declared among this vector index's filterFields.

options.text: Checking passes; the backend rejects the status filter.
options.rationale: The generated vector filter type rejects status before runtime too.

options.text: Checking fails; the search still returns only published hits.
options.rationale: Bypassing static checking does not add status to the index; runtime also rejects it.

options.text: Checking fails; the backend also rejects the status filter.
options.rationale: Both generated types and backend filter validation enforce the declared filterFields.

questions.concept: Hydrate vector IDs through one query from an action
questions.question: Which replacement obtains the documents?

options.rationale: One query gets all IDs while preserving positions, so the fixed projection pairs each document with its own score.
This can return the right documents but invokes the query once per hit, violating the visible single-query requirement when multiple hits exist.
ActionCtx has no direct database reader; database hydration must cross the query boundary.
fetchDocuments is a query; runMutation rejects its function kind.
